summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with the required docstring caveats. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md adds an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests, Black, and mypy were not executed, per instructions. Nothing committed.
